title: Adverb Collocations
description: The adverb + adjective and adverb + verb pairings that separate a grade A from a pass. Each set is one FUNCTIONAL CLASS, because the class is the lesson: a maximizer and a booster are not interchangeable, and 'highly ridiculous' is wrong for a reason a learner can state. The word bank holds ten adverbs and each is used exactly once, so elimination makes every answer defensible even where two adverbs would sound acceptable in isolation.
